'''Guardian Hold Six''' was a walker factory in [[Labor Valley]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was one of the [[Guardian Holds]], special fortified installations throughout [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. The [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]] [[Aelan Kalder]] seized control of the factory briefly during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
